verdicts.summary: The only hazards on this path are the two the findings already list: a bare `status:null` settles the item as stopped (finding 0), and a stale completed item gets reused by a later boundary (finding 1). I tried the other orderings and each settles the same item correctly.
verdicts.scenario: Orderings tried: (a) compacting, then boundary with no result frame. The boundary merges into the running item at 7185 and clears it at 7268, and a later success frame does nothing because compaction is null. (b) compacting, success, then the turn ends with no boundary. finalize at 6055 only emits while the item is running, so the row stays 'Context compacted' with no token counts. (c) A status frame from a subagent: parentToolUseIdFromSdkMessage returns null for system frames (2534), so it never reaches a settled context. (d) A turn item that has already settled gets a later update: the ingestor and projector simply upsert it (630-641, 303), so nothing is dropped.

verdicts.summary: A running compaction item cannot keep `isCompacting` true after its run ends. Web requires the item's run to equal `activeRuntime.activeRunId` and the phase to be running or connecting. Mobile requires the run to be active. The Claude adapter also settles a running item at turn end.
verdicts.scenario: Case tried: a running compaction item is left in the projection after its run ends, for example because the adapter died. On web, `compactionRunning` needs the item's runId to equal `activeRuntime.activeRunId` (2530), and `isCompacting` also needs the phase to be running or connecting (2534), so the next run is not marked as compacting. The timeline shimmer needs `workEntryIsInActiveRun`, which requires `isWorking` and the unsettled run (logic.ts:1400-1403). Mobile returns false unless the run is active (use-thread-composer-state.ts:336). Within a single run, how long the row stays running depends on the SDK sending a settle frame. That is runtime behaviour that cannot be read from the checkout.

verdicts.summary: Codex is a second producer of running compaction items, and neither note checks it. Under this commit, Codex auto-compaction also sets `isCompacting` on web and mobile, which blocks steering and shows 'Compacting…' while the Codex item runs.
verdicts.missing: Two things I could not settle from the checkout. First, whether the Codex app-server rejects or mishandles steer input during contextCompaction, which decides whether blocking it is intended. Second, whether Codex always sends item/completed for contextCompaction. The Codex adapter has no turn-end sweep that settles a running compaction item, so if item/completed never arrives, steering stays blocked for the rest of that Codex run.
verdicts.scenario: 1. A Codex thread starts a run. 2. Codex sends item/started with a contextCompaction item, and the adapter emits a running item (4621). 3. On web, `compactionRunning` is true (2526-2531), so `canSteer` is false (ChatComposer 3999). On mobile, `canSteerActiveTurn` is false (364). Before this commit, only a `/compact` message could block steering.
